articles.summary: The acclaimed ink-style action roguelite arrives on PC, PS5, Xbox Series & Nintendo Switch, featuring new content and a special character crossover revealed.February 26, 2026. Publisher 4Divinity, a publishing label of GCL Global Holdings [NASDAQ: GCL], and developer Leap Studio today announced that the highly anticipated fast-paced action roguelite Realm of Ink will officially launch on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, and Nintendo Switch on May 26 2026, releasing simultaneously with the game’s V1.0
articles.title: Realm of Ink Confirms Multiplatform Launch! Coming to PC & Consoles on May 26, 2026
